previous_statement: Apply lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws using A,B,k and 1.7.2-1.7.3. Its polar-inverse component u_delta is the first component of the inverse in 1.7.4: both invert the same polar map Pi_delta, and the inverse of the diffeomorphism is unique. new_statement: Applying lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws with A,B,k and the guards 1.7.2-1.7.3 yields the stated C^1 formulas, exact identities, and five A*epsilon_r estimates for the function that that external denotes u_delta. The two functions can be identified by uniqueness only if the group-laws function is known to be the first component of an inverse of this same typed Pi_delta; no allowed external or definition supplies that antecedent. Hence the earlier unconditional identification is withdrawn: the group-law conclusions do not, from the registered inputs alone, transfer to the root's explicitly bound inverse component.
